title: Discord bot
intro: Observed bot state and approved presentation settings. Game-server health and individual member synchronization are not measured here.
disabled: Management integration is disabled. An operator must configure the private connection before observations or changes are available.
polling: Refreshes every 30 seconds while this page is visible. No automatic retries of settings changes.
roleLimit: An empty queue does not prove that all guild members are synchronized.
saved: The bot accepted the settings. Check the application state below; persistence alone does not mean applied.
readonly: You may view these settings, but cannot configure the bot.
unsupported: Channel destinations, schedules, templates, grants, secrets and runtime controls are operator-managed and unavailable here.
review: Keep my edits and use the current revision
reviewHelp: Refresh, compare requested/effective values, then explicitly use the current revision before another save. Your edits remain in the form.

errors.unavailable: Current observations could not be verified. Previous values are historical; refresh before editing.
errors.forbidden: Access could not be verified or was revoked. No new bot data is shown. Sign in again or ask an operator to check your role.
errors.discord_required: This integration requires a verified Discord session and the bot's independent guild grant. Local recovery access cannot impersonate a Discord member.
errors.conflict: Another update changed the revision. Your edits are retained; refresh and compare before saving again.
errors.invalid: Check all fields. Labels must be 1–60 characters without mentions or markup; a reason is required.
errors.rate_limited: The bot is rate limited. Wait before refreshing again.
errors.unknown_outcome: The outcome is unknown. The bot may have committed your change. Your edits are retained. Refresh and compare the current revision; do not blindly repeat the save.
